newsitem.title: USA: Westco Bancorp Q1 net up on interest gain.
newsitem.headline: Westco Bancorp Q1 net up on interest gain.

text.p: Westco Bancorp Inc, the parent of 1st Federal Bank of Westchester, said increases in net interest income and non-interest income helped earnings in the first quarter climb from year-ago levels.
The company said net income in the period ended March 31 reached $1.1 million, or $0.39 a share, versus $969,234, or $0.34 a share one year ago.
Interest income rose $35,000 to $2.7 million and non-interest income climbed $74,000 to $212,020, Westco said.
The company said total assets dipped slightly to $309.9 million from $311.0 million.
Westco shares were off 5/8 Tuesday at 22.
